headlines.title: Democrat Mary Peltola wins Alaska’s Senate race, NBC News projects
headlines.description: NBC News projects Democrat Mary Peltola has defeated incumbent Sen. Dan S. Sullivan in Alaska’s Senate race. NBC News’ Steve Patterson reports on the midterm election outcome.

headlines.title: Secretary Duffy calls for air traffic control upgrades after meeting lawmakers
headlines.description: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy spoke to reporters after meeting with lawmakers in Congress about the Federal Aviation Administration's nationwide ground stop. NBC News' Tom Costello reports on what upgrades the secretary called for and the continued assertions that the issues were not caused by a hack.

headlines.title: Apple hit by widespread outages as tech problems continue
headlines.description: Apple Business, AppleCare, the App Store, Apple Music and other popular consumer-facing services were impacted by outages amid a recent surge in technical issues that impacted email, air travel, and online banking. NBC News’ Tom Costello reports.

headlines.title: Nvidia board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang, chairman says
headlines.description: The Nvidia board "does not intend to reinstate" Jensen Huang as CEO, the newly appointed board chair, Harvey Jones, said on their quarterly earnings call. NBC News' Allie Canal and Sahil Kapur discuss how Nvidia topped estimates despite Huang's ouster.

headlines.title: White House drops Heidi Overton’s FDA nomination after Republicans raise concerns
headlines.description: The White House is dropping Dr. Heidi Overton’s nomination to lead the Food and Drug Administration, a White House official confirmed Tuesday.

headlines.title: Highlights from Pope Leo’s historic, 12-day tour of South America
headlines.description: They turned out in their millions to greet Pope Leo as he made his way around Uruguay, Argentina and Peru on a gruelling 12-day tour of the South America.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: Nvidia enters the post-Jensen Huang era with a bang
headlines.description: Nvidia delivered a message with its first earnings report under new leadership: The sky isn’t falling.

headlines.title: Waymo pauses robotaxi rides on U.S. freeways after California ban
headlines.description: Waymo will stop putting its driverless vehicles on U.S. freeways for now.

headlines.title: Sean Duffy’s $50 billion demand for air travel fixes is met with yelling and skepticism in Congress
headlines.description: The Trump administration’s request for $50.1 billion in new FAA funding after a nationwide ground stop is running into skepticism from both parties in Congress.
